name: UpdateAccount
label: Update Salesforce Account
description: Updates an existing Account record in Salesforce using the provided credentials and account details.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: Resource
fields.label: Resource
fields.description: The Salesforce object to operate on. Must be 'Account'.

fields.name: Operation
fields.label: Operation
fields.description: The operation to perform on the resource. Must be 'Update'.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.label: Account ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Account to update (required).

fields.name: FieldUpdates
fields.label: Field Updates
fields.description: A dictionary of fields to update on the Account (e.g., Name, Phone, Industry).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce after updating the Account.
